name: app-sketch-to-ui-process-showcase
title: Hand sketches beside final screens on a blurred gradient
whatItIs: A case-study slide with a serif caption, and a two-row grid of phones: the top row shows hand-drawn paper wireframes inside phone frames; the bottom row shows the finished screens (score, insights, chat). The backdrop is a soft pink and orange gradient blur.
whatItMeans: Transparent, human and craft-focused; showing the sketch beside the result builds trust in the design thinking.
techniques: Place raw sketches in the same device frame as final screens so evolution reads instantly.
Use a soft aurora gradient behind neutral grey to add warmth without noise.
Centre a short serif caption above to tell the story in one line.
Arrange phones in a staggered grid so rows imply a journey from idea to product.
bestFor: Design system or product launch write-ups

vocabulary.definition: A simple structural sketch of a screen without visual styling.
A blurred multi-colour glow used as a backdrop.
A phone outline placed around a screen.
An image showing the steps behind a design.
